media.negative_prompt: photorealistic faces, anime style, western-only setting, Roman script labels, Devanagari script labels, digits or numerals anywhere in the lettering, generic Bollywood styling, north-Indian-only architecture, watermark, blurry, cluttered background, anachronistic objects, motivational poster layout, text banner with a moral, personified rain god or crowned king figure standing in the sky, deity portrait, halo, water-cycle diagram, arrows or scientific labels, flood-disaster imagery with damage or rescue, cartoon anthropomorphic animals standing or gesturing like people, tractor or modern farm machinery, harvest festival crowd
media.generation_prompt: A black-soil field on the edge of a Saurashtra village on the morning after heavy rain, the sky washed pale grey-blue with the last clouds breaking up. In the centre a farmer in a plain cotton shirt, dhoti and a cloth twisted round his head walks barefoot behind a wooden plough, leaning on its curved handle, driving a pair of white bullocks yoked together; the iron share cuts the wet dark earth and turns it over in a glistening ridge, and three or four fresh furrows already run away behind him towards the far edge of the field, each holding a thin line of rainwater. Egrets step along the new furrows behind the plough. Along the raised field boundary at the right stand a few sturdy cotton plants with open white bolls, and beside them a clump of tall millet with heavy grain heads bending over, drops still on the leaves. A thorn-fence, a lone acacia and low tile-roofed houses far behind. Warm morning light on wet black soil. Mood: the work beginning and what the field will give. At the bottom of the frame a narrow horizontal narrator bar carries exactly this Gujarati text, hand-lettered in Gujarati script, large and clearly legible, and no other lettering appears anywhere in the picture: ખેડૂત ખેતર ખેડશે રે Soft digital watercolour, vibrant textbook illustration style, 16:9.

notes: Reuse step is dormant in this pack: no Gujarati frame pool exists, so every scene carries image_url="" and an authored, self-contained generation_prompt. No [reused frame: ...] stamp appears anywhere.
scenes=9 counted off 05_with_content.json: every one of the nine topics carries "image" in available_content_types. No exercise block is a topic and none gets media.
Each topic carries exactly one image, homed on the topic's first concept; ids are concept-scoped and follow the chapter-continuous concept numbering (M1.S1.T1.C1 ... M2.S4.T9.C11).

Mixed chapter: M1 frames follow the lok_geet prior (the occasion; the tek topic's frame shows people singing together, never a lone poet), M2 frames follow the urmikavya_geet prior (that kadi's own picture). No narrator bar crosses the two parts - M1 bars quote only the lokgeet lines, M2 bars only the appended poem's lines.

Every narrator-bar string is character-for-character from that topic's own original_chunk; the printed refrain shorthand 'આવ્યો...' / '.... મેહુલા' is never lettered into a frame, and no bar carries a digit.

No frame draws the personified rain as a god, king or person, and the frog is drawn as an ordinary frog - the songs' figurative lines are kept as pictures of what is seen, per both profiles' 'literal reading of a figurative line' gate. No composer name appears in any media field.
